title: Blue Dala Horse Christmas Pattern
author: clipArtem
description:
Elegant blue-and-white Christmas surface pattern featuring a Scandinavian Dala horse, folk-art ornaments, holly, and sweeping damask scrollwork in rich indigo watercolour.
This sophisticated holiday repeat pattern blends Scandinavian folk tradition with classical damask elegance. The primary motif is a hand-painted Dala horse rendered in cobalt and cream, adorned with delicate floral folk-art details, suspended from a ribbon bow. Accompanying it are intricately decorated Christmas ball ornaments with blue botanical paintwork, clusters of deep indigo holly berries, and lush acanthus-style scrolling foliage interspersed with sharp holly leaves — all executed in a layered watercolour style on a warm ivory background.
The colour palette is a refined monochromatic indigo-to-slate-blue range against antique white, evoking the timeless aesthetic of Blue Delft pottery, Swedish folk art, and Chinese blue-and-white porcelain. The mood is festive yet sophisticated — cool, wintry, and heirloom-quality — making it equally at home on premium gift wrap, holiday fabric yardage, sublimation blanks, Christmas cushions, tote bags, table runners, and scrapbooking paper. The seamless damask structure ensures it tiles beautifully across any surface.
Perfect for Canva holiday templates, Procreate pattern brushes, Photoshop smart objects, POD products on Printify or Printful, and Creative Fabrica sublimation bundles. Designers, crafters, and small business owners will find this pattern ideal for creating upscale Christmas branding, stationery suites, wrapping paper collections, and seasonal home décor textiles.

title: Victorian Christmas Birds Holly Pattern
author: clipArtem
description:
Rich crimson vintage bird and holly surface pattern inspired by William Morris Arts and Crafts design.
This striking repeating pattern features song thrushes perched among densely layered holly branches, acanthus-style scrolling foliage, and clusters of vivid red berries set against a deep crimson red background. The botanical elements combine spiky holly leaves rendered in sage green and slate blue-grey with curling golden-tan acanthus fronds, while cream-white small flowers and pale berry clusters add delicate contrast. The illustrative linework is engraving-style, giving every leaf and feather a hand-drawn, antique etched quality that evokes 19th-century textile heritage.
The mood is richly festive yet refined — opulent without being kitsch, making it ideal for premium Christmas and holiday design projects. The deep red, olive green, steel blue, warm tan, and cream colour palette feels both traditional and elevated, working beautifully for fabric design, gift wrap, holiday stationery, scrapbooking paper, Christmas card backgrounds, sublimation printing, and POD products such as tote bags, mugs, wrapping paper, and throw pillows. The pattern tiles seamlessly at 13×13 inches at 300 DPI, making it production-ready for Spoonflower, Redbubble, Printify, Canva, Procreate, and Photoshop workflows.

title: William Morris Christmas Floral Pattern
author: clipArtem
description:
Lush Victorian botanical Christmas pattern with pine cones, holly berries, and cream hellebore blooms on deep navy blue.
This richly layered surface pattern draws direct inspiration from the Arts and Crafts movement, echoing the iconic style of William Morris with its dense, symmetrical botanical arrangement. Cream-toned hellebore flowers anchor the composition alongside sculptural brown pine cones, clusters of vivid crimson holly berries, white snowberries, and sweeping acanthus-style foliage rendered in sage green, dusty blue-green, and muted olive. The deep midnight navy background creates dramatic contrast that elevates every botanical element into sharp, jewel-toned focus.
The mood is one of refined, heritage-inspired Christmas elegance — neither kitschy nor overtly modern, but timeless and collectible. This pattern suits fabric yardage, quilting cotton, holiday throw pillow covers, gift wrapping paper, bookbinding cloth, Christmas stationery, greeting cards, and premium scrapbooking paper. It also translates beautifully to sublimation printing, Canva template backgrounds, Procreate pattern fills, Photoshop smart object mockups, and print-on-demand products such as tote bags, mugs, and festive apparel.
Designers and makers seeking an antique botanical Christmas aesthetic with a sophisticated navy colour palette will find this pattern immediately versatile and commercially strong across seasonal and evergreen product lines.
